historical_uid_census.files: all JSON including ignored and hidden files
historical_uid_census.method: rg parent_uid lines; extract 24-32 lowercase hexadecimal values from parent_uid keys; sort unique; compare original 16 train +4 diagnostic manifest
historical_uid_census.limitations: Only explicitly recorded parent_uid fields were censused; this is not an assertion that every past use or unrecorded inspection is discoverable.

family_grouping_evidence.suffix_rule: UID trailing 16 hexadecimal characters equality is a conservative source-family proxy, not verified ancestry.
family_grouping_evidence.recommendation: Before 32/8/8 splitting, union same UID, suffix16 proxy, and exact geometry groups. Exclude all resulting historical groups from validation/test.

historical_group_closure.rule: Transitive union over suffix16 equality and existing scan exact unordered triangle geometry hash

near_duplicate_scope.prior_scan_scope: Existing MeshFlow source datasets only; no generated output counted as object; exact triangle geometry comparison is orientation/face-order invariant but no approximate ancestry claim. No training/model/OT calls.
near_duplicate_scope.limitations: Existing exact geometry scan is orientation/face-order invariant. This audit does not certify semantic independence, normalized/rigid-transform duplicates, approximate surface similarity, or unknown source lineage. Parent Session A must record its own fresh geometry and preregistered near-duplicate checks.

preprocessing_pretraining_caveat: Official train/test separation and unseen conditional finetuning parent status do not establish that an object was unseen by official pretraining. The historical official checkpoint audit reports a Chair dataset config.
